requirements_matrix.requirement_text: Minimum 8 years of experience in business analysis and process improvement.
Strong experience with requirements gathering, stakeholder engagement, and workshops.
Ability to support digital transformation programmes in public sector environments.
Good communication skills in English and the ability to produce clear documentation.

profile: Alex Morgan is a Senior Business Analyst with 11 years of experience delivering business and digital transformation initiatives across public and private sector organisations. He brings strong expertise in requirements elicitation, process mapping, stakeholder facilitation, and benefits realisation across complex, multi-stakeholder environments. Alex has led discovery workshops, translated operational challenges into actionable requirements, and supported technology-enabled change from concept through implementation. He is recognised for clear communication, structured documentation, and collaborative leadership, with a strong focus on delivering measurable outcomes and improving service quality.

experience_overview.responsibilities: Alex leads requirements discovery and process improvement activities for a portfolio of service transformation initiatives. He works closely with senior stakeholders to align business needs with delivery priorities and to ensure clear, measurable outcomes.

Alex supported business change programmes by gathering requirements, preparing process documentation, and analysing operational pain points. He contributed to service redesign and improvement planning across multiple teams and departments.

Alex assisted with data collection, business process analysis, and workshop support for client improvement projects. He developed foundational experience in documentation, stakeholder engagement, and requirements analysis.

bullets: Facilitated discovery workshops with service leads, operational teams, and senior stakeholders to define business needs and improvement priorities.
Mapped current-state processes and identified service bottlenecks, producing a target operating model for digital service delivery improvements.
Created user stories, acceptance criteria, and business process documentation to support solution design and implementation planning.
Tracked benefits and KPI performance to ensure transformation activities aligned with service outcomes and governance requirements.
Gathered requirements from multiple departments to support the migration of paper-based records to a digital case management system.
Conducted process analysis and produced as-is and to-be process maps for operational teams and senior managers.
Coordinated testing activities, validated new workflows, and supported the resolution of functional issues during rollout.
Prepared service documentation and training materials to support adoption and minimise disruption to end users.
Collected operational data and stakeholder feedback to support improvement opportunities across client service processes.
Assisted with workshop facilitation and requirement documentation for process redesign initiatives.
Produced reports and dashboards to communicate findings and support decision-making by management teams.
Supported the development of business cases and implementation planning for selected improvement actions.
